backend/main.mo: Defines asset, portfolio, and user profile types, maintains maps for assets and user data, enforces access control, and exposes allowlisted HTTP-outcall methods for fetching market data.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata describing a required backend fix for a missing public initialization method enforcing frontend-backend API compatibility.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions for each frontend file, summarizing UI components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
Explains deployment failure due to a missing required public backend method `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`, causing frontend actor initialization errors.
frontend/docs/rebuild-checklist.md: Lists steps for rebuilding the frontend after backend API changes or interface mismatches.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based theme variables for light and dark modes using OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the frontend root and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures router, layout, Internet Identity initialization, and wraps authenticated routes with AppShell and AuthGate.
frontend/src/components/assets/AssetSear: Search component with live filtering of assets by name or ticker and selectable results list.
frontend/src/components/assets/MarketTyp: Dropdown selector mapping MarketType options to user-friendly labels.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication wrapper that shows login or triggers profile setup before rendering protected content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginPrompt: Renders the login landing page with Internet Identity sign‑in and feature highlights.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Empty file with no implementation content.
Provides the main app layout with header, navigation, theme toggle, logout handling, and footer.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/AddHol: Form for adding a holding with validation, submission via useAddHolding, and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Holdin: Displays a table of holdings with asset info, type badges, quantity, and purchase price.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog for entering and saving the user’s name using the profile save hook.
frontend/src/components/theme/ThemeToggl: Dropdown button allowing users to switch between light, dark, and system themes.
frontend/src/data/assetCatalog.ts: Static catalog of crypto, stock, commodity, and fiat assets grouped by market type.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddHolding.ts: Mutation hook for adding a holding, currently mocking backend behavior and invalidating portfolio queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAssetSearch.ts: Searches the static asset catalog by term and market type using memoization.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth state, including login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortfolio.ts: Defines a React Query hook that fetches the user's portfolio, currently returning a temporary empty portfolio until backend support is added.
frontend/src/hooks/usePriceRefreshPlaceh: Implements a periodic interval hook as a placeholder for future price‑refresh logic tied to market‑data integration.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles and defines light/dark theme color variables using OKLCH for the app’s UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAssetPage.tsx: Page for selecting an asset by market type and adding holding details to the portfolio.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the user's portfolio with loading states, empty‑state UI, and navigation to add assets, including a placeholder price refresh hook.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines frontend types for assets, holdings, portfolios, and market categories.
frontend/src/utils/assetSearch.ts: Provides a case‑insensitive search utility for filtering assets by ticker or name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session‑stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending themes, colors, fonts, and animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, versioning, and a detailed list of implemented features for an ICP-based portfolio tracker covering auth, dashboard, asset flows, storage, refresh logic, backend access control, and theming.
